proposed_widenings.name: replace_weapon_damage_type
proposed_widenings.justification: The passive rider changes the damage type of the weapon's existing hit from Piercing to Lightning on a hit, tied to this specific magic weapon. The current surface can add damage, modify numeric damage, or model one-shot damage, but it cannot replace a weapon hit's intrinsic damage type.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time you make an attack roll with this magic weapon and hit, you can have it deal Lightning damage instead of Piercing damage.

proposed_widenings.name: area_exclusion.exclude_self
proposed_widenings.justification: The Lightning Bolt property is close to an activation save-gate over a line area, but the line explicitly excludes the wielder. Current area attachment/origin shapes have no way to express an excluded source creature.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target and each other creature in the Line (excluding you) makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw

proposed_widenings.name: return_thrown_item_to_hand
proposed_widenings.justification: The activated property deterministically returns the same weapon to the wielder's hand immediately after resolution. The current surface has no authored item-return effect/lifecycle for a thrown item that briefly transforms and then returns.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Immediately after dealing this damage, the weapon reappears in your hand.

notes: Top-level fit is otherwise plausible as a composite magic item: a passive weapon rider plus a once-per-dawn activated ability using replace_attack and a fixed-DC line save. I did not author placeholder content because the passive rider cannot be encoded honestly with the current atoms.
